description: This is a PHP class file 'Settings.php' for the PhpSpreadsheet library. It defines a Settings class that manages configuration options such as chart renderer, locale, cache, and HTTP client settings for the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A static configuration class for managing various settings in the PhpSpreadsheet library, such as chart renderer, locale, cache, and HTTP client options.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for formula translations and formatting using Calculation class.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the current locale setting from the Calculation class.

methods.name: setChartRenderer
methods.description: Sets the chart rendering library if it implements IRenderer.

methods.name: getChartRenderer
methods.description: Returns the currently configured chart renderer class name.

methods.name: htmlEntityFlags
methods.description: Returns the default HTML entity flags (ENT_COMPAT).

methods.name: setLibXmlLoaderOptions
methods.description: Sets options for the libxml loader; deprecated.

methods.name: getLibXmlLoaderOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the options for the libxml loader; deprecated.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets the cache implementation for cell collection.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Gets the current cache implementation for cell collection, defaults if not set.

methods.name: useSimpleCacheVersion3
methods.description: Determines whether to use the version 3 simple cache based on PHP version and cache interface.

methods.name: setHttpClient
methods.description: Configures the HTTP client and request factory to be used for network requests.

methods.name: unsetHttpClient
methods.description: Unsets the configured HTTP client and request factory.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Returns the configured HTTP client, throws exception if not configured.

methods.name: getRequestFactory
methods.description: Returns the request factory, throws exception if not configured.
